response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack development skills and a diverse technical background, but his experience with C++ and industrial automation is limited compared to the role's core requirements. His expertise in secure coding, event-driven architectures, and mentorship is valuable, but the role's emphasis on C++, multi-threading, and industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) may not align perfectly with his recent work.
strengths: Extensive experience with event-driven architectures and message brokers (e.g., GISCollective platform).
Proven track record in secure coding practices, mentorship, and technical documentation (e.g., workshops, open-source contributions).
Strong problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration skills, with a focus on testable, high-quality code.
concerns: Limited recent hands-on experience with C++ (last noted in 2015 at National Instruments).
Primary expertise lies in TypeScript, Node.js, and web technologies, not industrial automation or embedded systems.
No explicit mention of industrial cybersecurity standards (e.g., IEC 62443) or multi-threading in high-performance systems.
